name: Aoi Kimi
source: [url=/c88294]Tori's[/url] older sister. She constantly badmouths Tori for being a foolish little brother, but cares greatly for him, as the only time she ever cried was over her brother's sadness at Horizon's death. She contracted the god of dance and sensuality, giving her various protection from being touched by anyone she doesn't want to. Her specialty is using her sensuality and dancing to avoid any attack. Moreover, almost everything she does such as putting on makeup and even moving is included as an offering.
